subject.title: feat(webui): reintroduce opt-in AI purpose titles for tool calls

question: Should OpenClaw accept a new default-off Control UI setting and gateway RPC that sends bounded tool arguments to utility-model providers and persists generated titles?
rationale: The implementation defects can be repaired mechanically, but accepting decorative provider egress, token spend, persistent cache state, and new public configuration and protocol surfaces requires explicit product ownership.

options.title: Accept after repair
options.body: Keep the opt-in design, but require all source findings, upgrade evidence, and exact-head real behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Retain deterministic UI
options.body: Decline the model-backed title path and keep current main's deterministic tool rendering without decorative provider calls.

recommendation.title: Accept after repair
recommendation.body: Keep the opt-in design, but require all source findings, upgrade evidence, and exact-head real behavior proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The related issue, original implementation, intentional removal, and current shared-path history all point to this person as the best available decision owner.
